# Supreme Court of the United States

> The official website of the Supreme Court of the United States, providing access to opinions, oral arguments, case documents, docket information, and filing procedures.

The Supreme Court website serves as the authoritative source for Supreme Court opinions, oral argument transcripts and audio, case documents, and procedural guidance for attorneys and the public. It provides comprehensive legal research tools including the docket search, case citation finder, and access to United States Reports.

## Key Topics

- Supreme Court Opinions
- Oral Arguments
- Case Documents
- Docket Search
- U.S. Reports
- Electronic Filing
- Supreme Court Bar
- October Term
- Slip Opinions
- Argument Transcripts
- Certiorari
- Rules of the Supreme Court
- Justices
- Case Citations
- Legal Research

## Core Resources

- [Home - Supreme Court of the United States](https://www.supremecourt.gov): Supreme Court of the United States homepage with access to opinions, arguments, and court information.
- [Opinions - Supreme Court of the United States](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/opinions.aspx): Central repository for Supreme Court opinions and United States Reports legal decisions.
- [Oral Arguments - Supreme Court of the United States](https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/oral_arguments.aspx): Supreme Court oral arguments with transcripts, audio, and courtroom access information.
- [Case Documents](https://www.supremecourt.gov/case_documents.aspx): Supreme Court case documents including briefs, orders, and certiorari petitions.
- [Docket Search - Supreme Court of the United States](https://www.supremecourt.gov/docket/docket.aspx): Searchable docket database for Supreme Court cases with status and email notifications.

## Opinions and Legal Decisions

- [Opinions of the Court - 2025](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/slipopinion/25): 2025 term slip opinions including cases like Olivier v. City of Brandon and Urias-Orellana v. Bondi.
- [U.S. Reports](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/USReports.aspx): Official United States Reports publication with preliminary prints and bound volumes access.
- [Opinions Relating to Orders - 2025](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/relatingtoorders/25): 2025 term opinions relating to certiorari orders including Burnett v. United States.
- [In-Chambers Opinions](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/in-chambers.aspx): In-chambers opinions on interim relief and stay applications from individual Justices.
- [Case Citation Finder - Supreme Court of the United States](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/casefinder.aspx): Search tool for finding Supreme Court cases by citation in United States Reports.

## Oral Arguments and Transcripts

- [Argument Transcripts](https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/argument_transcript.aspx): Transcripts of Supreme Court oral arguments prepared by Heritage Reporting Corporation.
- [Argument Audio](https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/argument_audio.aspx): Audio recordings of Supreme Court oral arguments from National Archives.
- [Calendars and Lists](https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/calendarsandlists.aspx): Supreme Court oral argument schedules and calendars for October Terms 2023-2026.
- [Courtroom Seating](https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/courtroomseating.aspx): Courtroom seating chart with Justice positions and public access lottery information.

## Filing and Court Rules

- [Filing and Rules](https://www.supremecourt.gov/filingandrules): Supreme Court filing procedures, rules, bar admission, and litigation guidance.
- [Electronic Filing](https://www.supremecourt.gov/filingandrules/electronicfiling.aspx): Guide to electronic filing system for Supreme Court document submission and procedures.
- [Rules and Guidance](https://www.supremecourt.gov/filingandrules/rules_guidance.aspx): Supreme Court rules, filing guidance, and procedures for briefs and case submissions.
- [Supreme Court Bar](https://www.supremecourt.gov/filingandrules/supremecourtbar.aspx): Supreme Court Bar admission requirements and application instructions.

## Legal Research and Reference

- [Online Sources Cited in Opinions for the 2025 Term](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/urls_cited.aspx): Database of online sources and URLs cited in 2025 term Supreme Court opinions.
- [Media Files Cited in Opinions - Supreme Court of the United States](https://www.supremecourt.gov/media/media.aspx): Media files and audio-visual records cited in Supreme Court opinions.
